summary: I fixed the bug in `solution/core.py`, and the visible suite now passes (2 passed). When `merge` combined overlapping or contained intervals, it set the merged end to the later interval's end (`(pa, b)`). That shrank the result whenever one interval sat inside another, for example `(1,4)` and `(2,3)` gave `(1,3)`. It now keeps the larger of the two ends, `(pa, max(pb, b))`. I didn't change anything else, including the touching and duplicate handling.
